effective_evaluation.pairing: exact initial states and actual physical parameters for every policy within each condition and seed
effective_evaluation.policy_action: deterministic mean using saved observation normalizers
effective_evaluation.checkpoint_selection: final only; no test-guided checkpoint selection
effective_evaluation.primary_metric: per-episode instantaneous world-vx tracking RMSE versus 0.10m/s at 50Hz, then mean over episodes for each training seed
secondary_metrics: actual joint acceleration RMS at control sampling rate
effective_evaluation.statistics: n=3 independent training seeds per arm; report each seed and sample SD across seed means, not episode SEM as training variability
effective_evaluation.scenario_status: 3042/4042 unused in policy training but previously observed in the DR study; fixed common re-evaluation, not a new blind test
